consumptionRule: effective area weather = #61 producer output filtered/weighted by the area's region climate record; #67 behaviour keys to the effective state; border zones (#140) read an authored seam, not a computed winner
hardCanon: Dark Forest depths: weather NONE (#61) — no climate record may override
Frost nights = the named composite night + frost-trace (#19); Region 1's record references it, never redefines it
note: Region 1: record references the #61/#67 tables as they stand; its climate identity name is OPEN. Regions 2-5: null slot records only — identities are design-lane inputs, invented nowhere in this package.
